extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media planning to cover the Endocrine Society/ENDO 2026 meeting or seeking Endocrine Society press materials/interviews
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and contact details for media who want to cover ENDO 2026 in person or remotely, to request interviews with Society experts, and to register to receive embargoed press releases from the Society's journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media registration to cover ENDO 2026
rubrics_metrics.description: Media registration for ENDO 2026 is open! Register here to cover the meeting in person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you plan to cover the meeting in person you must register (link provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Remote coverage media list sign-up
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are planning to cover the meeting remotely, please email [email protected] to be added to our media list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remote/virtual coverage requires emailing the provided address to be added to the media list — do not rely on in-person registration for remote coverage access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview requests with Society experts
rubrics_metrics.description: Our experts are available to discuss all hormone health topics. Please contact us to set up an interview with one of our experts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media should contact the communications/media relations team in advance to arrange expert interviews; the page implies proactive outreach is required to schedule interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register to receive embargoed press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Register to receive embargoed press releases on the latest research from our four peer-reviewed journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists who want access to embargoed material must register (presumably via the media list or registration flow); this registration is the route to receive pre-publication press materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided media contacts for press inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Contacts: Colleen Williams, Associate Director, Communications and Media Relations (Phone: (202)-971-3611, [email protected]); Jenni Glenn Gingery, Director, Communications and Media Relations (Phone: (202)-971-3655, [email protected]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct media inquiries, interview requests, and registration questions to the named communications staff by phone or email; the page lists specific contacts as the proper channel for media relations.
